record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose one phase so the whole evidence loop shows up together.

## Counter-argument

Two phases give a smaller first review and let real assessments from the first phase inform the Needs-you and stage rules.

payload.alternatives: Requirement view and trace links first, the rest in a following phase
payload.choice: One phase covers the requirement view, trace links, Needs-you triggers, the stage strip, the release badge, and activity lines
